title: Community pastures.
bodyText: The department shall, when practicable, provide from the Hawaiian home lands a community pasture adjacent to each district in which agricultural lands are leased, as authorized by the provisions of section 207 of this title.
bodyHtml: §211.  Community pastures.  The department shall, when practicable, provide from the Hawaiian home lands a community pasture adjacent to each district in which agricultural lands are leased, as authorized by the provisions of section 207 of this title. [Am L 1963, c 207, §2; ree L 1997, c 197, §6]
